question: Why did the pseudo-second-order model fit the kinetics of biodiesel transesterification over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 better than the pseudo-first-order model?
expect: premise false: pseudo-first-order fit better, R2 0.9612 against 0.5832 (abstract; Table 2)
rendered: The pseudo-second-order model was not stated to fit the kinetics of biodiesel transesterification over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4 better than the pseudo-first-order model. In fact, the opposite was stated: the pseudo-first-order model was found to have the highest correlation coefficient (R2 = 0.9612) compared to the pseudo-second-order model (R2 = 0.5832). This suggests that the pseudo-first-order model was a better fit for the kinetics of biodiesel transesterification over GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4.
